answer: A time-locked stake works like a rental deposit you cannot touch for 20 epochs. Each identity locks 150 units, and honest work unlocks 5% per epoch. Forgery is like trashing the apartment: 60% of the stake is forfeited and the timer resets. A vine of locked stakes ties each identity's funds to its behavior, and a copper audit seal stops one deposit backing two identities. A crystal-clear ledger shows every lock and release. Cost math: 1,000 identities lock 150,000 units, and with 30% caught forging, the attacker loses 27,000 units and waits 10 more epochs.
